<view class="{{className}}">
  <!-- Trigger -->
  <view 
    class="multiselect-trigger" 
    bindtap="onTriggerTap"
    data-disabled="{{disabled}}"
  >
    <text class="multiselect-label">
      {{api.value.length > 0 ? '已选 ' + api.value.length + ' 项' : placeholder}}
    </text>
    <text class="multiselect-arrow">▼</text>
  </view>

  <!-- ActionSheet Overlay -->
  <view 
    wx:if="{{api.open}}" 
    class="multiselect-overlay" 
    bindtap="onBackdropTap"
  ></view>
  
  <!-- ActionSheet Content -->
  <view 
    wx:if="{{api.open}}" 
    class="multiselect-content"
    data-state="{{api.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
  >
    <view class="multiselect-header">
      <text class="multiselect-title">{{label || placeholder}}</text>
      <view class="multiselect-close" bindtap="onBackdropTap">×</view>
    </view>
    
    <scroll-view scroll-y class="multiselect-list">
      <view 
        wx:for="{{items}}" 
        wx:key="{{itemValueKey}}"
        class="multiselect-item"
        data-value="{{item[itemValueKey] || item}}"
        mark:value="{{item[itemValueKey] || item}}"
        bindtap="onItemTap"
        data-selected="{{api.value.includes(item[itemValueKey] || item)}}"
      >
        <view class="multiselect-checkbox" data-checked="{{api.value.includes(item[itemValueKey] || item)}}">
          <text wx:if="{{api.value.includes(item[itemValueKey] || item)}}">✓</text>
        </view>
        <text>{{item[itemLabelKey] || item}}</text>
      </view>
    </scroll-view>

    <view class="multiselect-footer">
      <view class="multiselect-confirm-btn" bindtap="onConfirmTap">
        确认 ({{api.value.length}})
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>
